Definition: Arjok, the name of two Babylonians
BiblicalUsage: Arioch is the name of two men, centuries apart, and both stand beside kings. Arioch king of Ellasar goes to war with Chedorlaomer against the kings of the plain, and Arioch captain of the king's guard is sent to slay the wise men of Babylon, but brings Daniel to the king instead.
TheologicalSignificance: A name shared by a king of war and a captain of the guard tells me that God puts His people in the path of powerful men, and that the captain who was sent to kill becomes the one who brings Daniel to the throne room.
